title: fumaria muralis var. major
intro: Fumaria muralis var. major, commonly known as Wall Fumitory, is a plant species in the genus Fumaria, which is characterized by its small, white or pink flowers and branching stems. The health benefits of Wall Fumitory include its use in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in the treatment of conditions like urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Wall Fumitory include alkaloids such as fumaritine, fumaridine, and fumaridine alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
